elements.label: Figure 3.5
elements.title: Graph of the Binomial Distribution for n = 20 and p = 0.92

details.trend: Probability increases from 14 to peak at 19, then decreases at 20.

elements: This bar chart shows the binomial probability distribution for the number of successes x in 20 trials with success probability 0.92. It highlights that the most likely outcomes are 18 and 19 successes, with probabilities around 27% and 32%, respectively.
